mount_sampler@0.0.1:fact/riding.meaning: Whether the character is riding this mount.

text.dialogue.horse.prompt: The horse flicks an ear at you.
text.narration.horse.dismount: You slide down from the saddle.
text.narration.horse.mount: You swing up into the saddle.
text.npc.horse.description: A patient bay horse with a worn saddle.
text.npc.horse.saddled: The bay horse stands under you, saddled.
text.room.fen.description: A fen; no horse will set a hoof in it. The ground gives under every step. The road is west.
text.room.fen.title: Fen
text.room.ford.description: The road fords a mire on laid stones. The yard is north.
text.room.ford.title: Ford
text.room.road.description: A packed road north of the yard. A fen spreads east.
text.room.road.title: Road
text.room.yard.description: A cobbled yard. A road runs north; a ford lies south.
text.room.yard.title: Yard
